gaps.sentence: The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.

gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.

gaps.explanation: 'Her confidence' — the noun; 'confident' is the adjective.
'Studying management' — the field is called management.
'Needs revising' = needs to be revised — need + -ing.

gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).
This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.
